description: This file defines an enumeration called MetricType representing various metric types used in the Eclipse Ditto project. Each enum value includes a name, a list of supported metric directions, and utility methods for processing metric types.

classes.name: MetricType
classes.description: An enum that defines known metric types, their names, and supported metric directions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the label used in JSON representation for the MetricType.

methods.name: supportsDirection
methods.description: Checks whether a given MetricDirection is supported by this MetricType.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional containing the MetricType matching the specified name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string name of the MetricType.

search-terms: known metric types in Eclipse Ditto
